name: Bink
summary: In Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries, Bink teaches aspiring mages the arcane arts. Her quick mind helps promising students find wizards across the Alliance.

sections.title: A Beacon in the Hall of Mysteries
sections.body:
In Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries, Bink teaches the path of the mage. She works among the scholars, priests, and arcanists gathered in the Mystic Ward. Like many gnomes driven from Gnomeregan, she has made her home in the dwarven mountain stronghold. Her keen mind and skill in arcane craft guide those learning magic.

Bink knows wizards across the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor. She points promising apprentices toward mentors such as High Sorcerer Andromath in Stormwind and Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.answer: Bink trains Alliance gnome mages in Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries. She teaches arcane spellcraft and guides mages as they develop.
You can find Bink in the Hall of Mysteries, in the western wing of Ironforge's Mystic Ward.

Developing mages are directed to Bink by Speak with Bink. She sends them to study with authorities such as High Sorcerer Andromath in Stormwind's Wizard's Sanctum or the hermit mage Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.q: What does Bink say to non-mages?
faq.answer: If you do not practice the arcane, Bink cheerfully advises, 'Befriend a mage! We have a trick or two up our sleeves, we do...'

angles.text: As an Alliance mage in Ironforge, you can learn from Bink and follow her guidance to powerful mentors across Azeroth.
As a gnome, you share Bink's pursuit of arcane mastery among exiles sheltered in the halls of their dwarven allies.
